title: Rex and the First Snowplow
synopsis: A winter morning changes Brook Road overnight; Rex, Gus and Jack watch a prepared town plow make its first slow pass from the warm blue-step house.
continuity_state: Before: Months have passed since the firehouse open day. It is now winter. Rex lives at the blue-step house; Jack has a rain gauge at Pine Park, and Captain Ann and both fire trucks are stationed on Station Lane. After: A substantial overnight snowfall has covered the town. A town-operated orange snowplow has begun clearing Brook Road, its wing mirror and front blade distinct from existing trucks. Rex, Gus and Jack are home with Aunt Jo after observing its first pass. The park paths and long farm road await further work.
